rasa.dominant: śānta with adbhuta weight (rest in the installed form; wonder at the liṅga-rite)
rasa.justification: The ahnika installs — mantras, materials, worship — and each installation rests; wonder at the installed form crowns the rite, and the installed form is the resting-place.

sections.SUMMARY: The mode of worship of the emblem, hinted in the Malini. Secret mantras of the higher shastras are not to be installed outside: secrecy is their siddhi. Their siddhi comes from entry into the greatness of own vigor-bliss; externality is form-loss. Shiva is Samave-sha-full, enjoyer-natured; interruption of enjoyment-lust-enjoyment is nigraha. Produced from peace-surpassing-rite-hunger-increased body, itself installed, by which he in enjoyment perishes. Jnanottara says: Shiva is sacrifice-loving, especially in the mothers' midst. Therefore the wise should not install the secret mantras outside, especially manifest-formed ones. For the dead, installation elsewhere was enjoined; that here in shastras is not to be done — common installation again. Up to tanmayatva-accomplishment, from desired-fruit-arising: putraka, sadhaka, manifest-unmanifest, or should resort to. By putrakas guru is to be requested; sadhaka but himself knowing: if he should install not, if then also to be requested, guru should become. In so-called nirodha: time thus in the Lord he should say; living in this until fruit-end, you should stand until life-end — or. Linga: Bana-linga, gem-born, pearl, flower-food, cloth, scent-substance-made. But not stone-born sculptor-risen; metal-risen except gold reject. Not linga-measure here anywhere used; by noble vigor-mantras what is shone, fruit-giving, for that. Of it also by altar-and-the-rest-enjoined-rite he should purify; mantra-offering likewise should be nirodha as said by reason. In fire and tarpana, by abundance especially dakshina of guru, poor-and-the-rest-satisfaction-abundance-sacrifice: thus superior rite. In all unmanifest lingas primary should be unconstructed; so and there there-said in mark in Parameshvara. In thread, vessel, banner, cloth, svayambhu-Bana-worshipped, river-spring-risen: and no calling, nor even construction. Seat-temple-mantra-portion-time-rule, and not manifest or in painting-book-and-the-rest, god-wood-gold-born. Now by initiated good-artisan-made installs guru, or-else mark-endowed-head-shell-supported. By row-chakra-trishula-lotus-rite should resort to tura; its mark I speak, in venerable Picu-shastra was set forth. In tura yoga always is praised, giver of siddhi in faultless; by nets-torn, by holes-teeth-deficient-excess disease. In suitable and in tura loss would be, in its deficient sacrifice supreme; desired indeed would-be-tura — thus some adopted. Gurus but in rite, in desired, from effort reject faults — thus they explain Picu-spoken; not in obligatory rite — thus this. In venerable Siddhatantra was said and tura-mark-supreme: in one-to-four-fragment, in cow-mouth, in full-moon. In lotus-go-rocanā-pearl-salt-crystal-like, in one-to-five-hundred-holes-vidya-line-possessing, in auspicious. Not in rough-crooked-fragment-long-depressed-with-bindu: by smooth, by diamond-needle here, clearly, goddess-group-possessing. All should draw worshipful, all-limbs-beautiful; this very should follow in argha-vessel also, mark. In venerable Brahmayamala was said: vessel, cow-mouth-supreme, elephant-tortoise-base, pot-round-shakti-born-form. Bead-thread and should make there indeed worship sequence, hero-substance-water-born-pearl-gem-gold-born. Bead-thread, sequence-extracted, rudraksha, or especially hundred, tithi-superior, or-even with-eight, or-even its-half. Its-half, or-then fifty-joined, he should consider that; mouths five, from consciousness-pulse-knowledge-will-action-union. Fivefold-end-going, unity-thus-penultimate-bead-going, rite, by shakti-and-its-division: there two-form is said. Then in double-measure but two-formed nyasa he should perform; then even in double, by creation-dissolution-pair, him. Matrka, Malini, or-then: he should place in ether-sixteen-measured; in supreme but two, having-placed-having-placed, before impelled-ones. In initiation primarily mantras those fifteen, the daishika; if or by tattva-bhuvana-kala-mantra-pada-phoneme. By number-differences in made in thread: him him nyasa guru should perform; having-made bead-thread, of it also all should be as altar. By worshipped and by that very japa should perform undistracted: rite said this in venerable Malinivijayottara. Wheel-like-whirling-this-what-he-says: he japa would be; if he sees, he offers this in awakening-fire, from entering. Or argha-great-vessel should make that supreme param; coconut-and, bilva, golden, silver, and or. Of it also this rite all in installation-beginning was declared; by its unshaking fluids full, having made in this worship sequence. Downward-faced always to be placed; worshipped in worship again, that vessel upward-faced; and that empty should make not, such. At worship-end, that-fluid-full-self having disposed, that downward-faced and having fully worshipped, he should place, the wise. Sword, dagger, or-even scissors, mirror, and or, pure, so-thus should make as venerable Kali-mouth spoken. In venerable Bhairavakula was said in Kula-festival-pre-worship: on altar-in-fire, on cloth, on linga, on vessel, on lotus-then, on mandala. On image, on pot-in-heap, on brick, on thread-then: should worship by own, by own service; mixture should reject — thus. As in waters for peace, mantras so in weapons and the rest certainly; enemy-cutting-and-the-rest-doers, desired from, mixture abandoned. Of the desireless but they, from that-that-place-condition-power certainly: fetter-cutting-purified-tattva-nourishing-and-the-rest-doers. Or-else book, such-seizing-shastra-sequence-possessing, well-purified, by-initiated-made: there also this rite is remembered. Thus in self-installations, as long as standing is: by abundance tarpana, purity so long interruption-avoidance. Hence indeed when many-days mandala-construction: then in-day in-day should perform by abundance tarpana, much. In installation and everywhere guru, aforesaid supreme, having sought true reality, presence he should make clear. In accomplished but in tanmayatva-state in fruit, by putraka-sadhakas to another, from that pair to either, that is offered. Of it also this rite all in its absence but in every way: in deep water it to be cast, having asked pardon, having dismissed, and. Thus this self-installation-rite, Shiva-set-forth: in other-installed in linga, in Bana-then, in svayambhu. In all-asana-side, having placed before, should worship sequence: pure-impure-adhva-ones, all mantras, all Shiva-ending. Adhva and here in seat was said that everywhere worship this; invocation-dismissal but there as before should perform. Was said in tantra also Aghoresha, in Svacchanda, by Lord; so or-else daily as said by half-half-portion-appointment. Having made desired mandala there, all sequence should worship, of much kind different, linga-worship was set forth.

(44-49) book support, self-installation (as long as standing, abundance-tarpana, purity, no interruption), many-day mandala: daily abundance-tarpana; installation everywhere: guru makes presence clear; tanmayatva/fruit: transfer to another putraka/sadhaka; transfer rite (deep water cast, pardon, dismiss); Shiva-set-forth self-installation for Bana/svayambhu lingas; all-adhva-as-asana worship with all mantras from impure to Shiva;
